## Overview

This is a legacy script from the earlier all-site analysis (primary tumours plus metastatic biopsies from bone, lymph node and soft tissue). It is included for transparency and is not part of the bone-only pipeline. It added the per-AOI tumour purity estimate supplied with the data (ESTIMATE) to the RUV-covariate, patient-blocked non-responder versus responder model of phase4. It then classified each earlier hit as purity-robust, purity-driven (lost after adjustment) or new after adjustment. It also tested whether purity differed by response group within each stratum, and between archival and pre-treatment samples within each compartment.

Its frozen top tables with purity (`data/previous_analysis/Phase5_Purity/*_toptable_with_purity.csv`) are read by comp_18. comp_18 shows that purity adjustment reproduces the direction of the earlier named genes but not their transcriptome-wide significance at patient level.

**Figures, tables and results supported**

- Extended Data Fig. 8a (earlier AOI-level gene counts with ESTIMATE purity as a covariate), via comp_18 reading the frozen `data/previous_analysis/Phase5_Purity/*_toptable_with_purity.csv`
- Results: Re-evaluation of earlier neuroendocrine, purity and bone-niche findings

**Pipeline step:** `./run_pipeline.sh --legacy` (optional; not needed to reproduce the current analysis, whose frozen inputs are in `data/previous_analysis/`). Approximate runtime: minutes to tens of minutes.

**Inputs**

- `results_legacy/phase3_ruv_results.rds`
- `results_legacy/phase4_de_results.rds`

**Outputs**

- `results_legacy/previous_analysis/Phase5_Purity/*_toptable_with_purity.csv (frozen copies in data/previous_analysis/Phase5_Purity/)`
- `results_legacy/phase5_purity_results.rds`
- `results_legacy/phase5_summary_table.csv`

**Depends on**: `phase3_normalization`, `phase4_DE`

## Analysis

### Legacy purity adjustment

The header explains the source of the purity estimate and the aim, which was to separate purity-robust from purity-driven hits.

Sets the working directory to `results_legacy/` and loads the phase3 and phase4 results.

```{r phase5-purity-covariate-01}
## ============================================================================
## PRINCE Trial GeoMx DSP -- Phase 5: Tumour Purity as a Covariate
##
## tumour.purity.estimate (colData, no NAs in any of the 6 strata) is used
## directly -- it's already a marker-based purity estimate provided with the
## trial data (Phase 6 deconvolution will provide an independent cross-check
## later). Re-runs each stratum's primary (RUV-covariate) NRvsR contrast from
## Phase 4 with purity added as an extra covariate, and reports which Phase 4
## hits are purity-robust vs purity-driven.
## ============================================================================

suppressMessages({
  library(SummarizedExperiment); library(dplyr)
  library(edgeR); library(limma); library(ggplot2)
})

PRINCE_ROOT <- normalizePath(Sys.getenv("PRINCE_ROOT", "."))
RAW_DIR <- file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "data", "interim")     # all-site QC'd objects written by comp_00a_qc
dir.create(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"), showWarnings = FALSE)
setwd(file.path(PRINCE_ROOT, "results_legacy"))           # legacy outputs; frozen copies used downstream are in data/previous_analysis
dir.create("Results/Phase5_Purity", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

phase3 <- readRDS("phase3_ruv_results.rds")
phase4 <- readRDS("phase4_de_results.rds")

get_W <- function(entry) {
  if (!is.null(entry$W)) return(entry$W)
  aname <- paste0("RUVIIIprps_k_", entry$chosen_k)
  entry$se@metadata$RUVIII$W[[aname]]
}

```

### Purity versus response group

Within each stratum, the script fits `purity ~ response group` at AOI level and reports R², the F-test P and the group means.

```{r phase5-purity-covariate-02}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 1: purity vs response_group_neat, per stratum
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("================ PURITY vs RESPONSE GROUP, PER STRATUM ================\n")
purity_assoc <- list()
for (stratum_id in names(phase3)) {
  cd <- phase3[[stratum_id]]$cd
  bio <- droplevels(factor(cd$response_group_neat))
  fit <- lm(tumour.purity.estimate ~ bio, data = cd)
  r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  pval <- tryCatch(anova(fit)$`Pr(>F)`[1], error = function(e) NA)
  cat(sprintf("%-22s R2=%.3f  p=%.4f  (purity by group: %s)\n", stratum_id, r2, pval,
              paste(round(tapply(cd$tumour.purity.estimate, bio, mean), 3), collapse = " / ")))
  purity_assoc[[stratum_id]] <- data.frame(stratum = stratum_id, r2 = r2, pval = pval)
}
purity_assoc_tab <- bind_rows(purity_assoc)

```

### Purity versus timepoint

Within each compartment, archival and pre-treatment AOIs are pooled and purity is compared between timepoints.

```{r phase5-purity-covariate-03}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 2: purity vs timepoint, per segment (pooling Archival + Screening)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n================ PURITY vs TIMEPOINT, PER SEGMENT (pooled Archival+Screening) ================\n")
for (seg in c("CD45+", "PSMA+", "PanCK+PSMA-")) {
  arch_id <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", seg), "__Archival")
  scr_id  <- paste0(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "", seg), "__Screening")
  cd_a <- phase3[[arch_id]]$cd; cd_s <- phase3[[scr_id]]$cd
  pooled <- rbind(data.frame(purity = cd_a$tumour.purity.estimate, timepoint = "Archival"),
                   data.frame(purity = cd_s$tumour.purity.estimate, timepoint = "Screening"))
  fit <- lm(purity ~ timepoint, data = pooled)
  r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
  pval <- anova(fit)$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  cat(sprintf("%-14s R2=%.3f  p=%.4f  (mean purity Archival=%.3f, Screening=%.3f)\n", seg, r2, pval,
              mean(cd_a$tumour.purity.estimate), mean(cd_s$tumour.purity.estimate)))
}

```

### Differential expression with purity

Refits the phase4 model (RUV factors, two-pass blocking, voomWithQualityWeights, robust eBayes) with purity added as a covariate. FDR < 0.05 hits are compared with phase4: purity-robust, purity-driven (lost) and new after adjustment. Top tables and the summary are written.

```{r phase5-purity-covariate-04}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Step 3: re-run NRvsR with purity added to the RUV-covariate design
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n================ DE WITH PURITY ADDED TO RUV-COVARIATE MODEL ================\n")

run_limma_voom_purity <- function(counts, bio, pid, W, purity) {
  design_base <- model.matrix(~0 + bio)
  colnames(design_base) <- make.names(colnames(design_base))
  colnames(W) <- paste0("W", seq_len(ncol(W)))
  design <- cbind(design_base, W, purity = purity)
  dge <- DGEList(counts); dge <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
  v1 <- voom(dge, design, plot = FALSE)
  dupcor1 <- duplicateCorrelation(v1, design, block = pid)
  v2 <- voomWithQualityWeights(dge, design, block = pid, correlation = dupcor1$consensus, plot = FALSE)
  dupcor2 <- duplicateCorrelation(v2, design, block = pid)
  fit <- lmFit(v2, design, block = pid, correlation = dupcor2$consensus)
  bio_cols <- colnames(design_base)
  nr_col <- bio_cols[grepl("Non_Responder", bio_cols)]
  r_col  <- bio_cols[grepl("Responder", bio_cols) & !grepl("Non_Responder", bio_cols)]
  cm <- makeContrasts(contrasts = paste0(nr_col, " - ", r_col), levels = design)
  fit2 <- eBayes(contrasts.fit(fit, cm), robust = TRUE)
  topTable(fit2, number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
}

summary_rows <- list()
robustness_details <- list()

for (stratum_id in names(phase3)) {
  entry <- phase3[[stratum_id]]
  cd <- entry$cd
  counts <- assay(entry$se, "all_count")
  bio <- droplevels(factor(cd$response_group_neat))
  pid <- factor(cd$subject_id)
  W <- get_W(entry)
  purity <- cd$tumour.purity.estimate

  tt_purity <- run_limma_voom_purity(counts, bio, pid, W, purity)
  tt_noPurity <- phase4$de_results[[stratum_id]]$fit_with$toptable

  sig_purity <- rownames(tt_purity)[tt_purity$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
  sig_noPurity <- rownames(tt_noPurity)[tt_noPurity$adj.P.Val < 0.05]
  purity_robust <- intersect(sig_noPurity, sig_purity)
  purity_driven <- setdiff(sig_noPurity, sig_purity)
  new_after_purity <- setdiff(sig_purity, sig_noPurity)

  cat(sprintf("\n%s : DE (no purity)=%d | DE (+purity)=%d | purity-robust=%d | purity-driven(lost)=%d | new-after-purity=%d\n",
              stratum_id, length(sig_noPurity), length(sig_purity), length(purity_robust),
              length(purity_driven), length(new_after_purity)))

  write.csv(tt_purity, file.path("Results/Phase5_Purity", paste0(stratum_id, "_toptable_with_purity.csv")))
  robustness_details[[stratum_id]] <- list(purity_robust = purity_robust, purity_driven = purity_driven,
                                            new_after_purity = new_after_purity)
  summary_rows[[stratum_id]] <- data.frame(
    stratum = stratum_id, n_sig_no_purity = length(sig_noPurity), n_sig_with_purity = length(sig_purity),
    n_purity_robust = length(purity_robust), n_purity_driven_lost = length(purity_driven),
    n_new_after_purity = length(new_after_purity)
  )
}

summary_tab <- bind_rows(summary_rows)
cat("\n\n================ PHASE 5 SUMMARY ================\n")
print(summary_tab, row.names = FALSE)

saveRDS(list(purity_assoc = purity_assoc_tab, summary_table = summary_tab,
             robustness_details = robustness_details),
        "phase5_purity_results.rds")
write.csv(summary_tab, "phase5_summary_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nSaved phase5_purity_results.rds, phase5_summary_table.csv, and per-stratum",
    "topTables under Results/Phase5_Purity/\n")
cat("Phase 5 script complete.\n")
```
